text: 证监会发布关于同意中金公司吸收合并东兴证券、信达证券的批复。根据批复，中金公司将通过新增股份的方式吸收合并东兴证券和信达证券，合并完成后，两家证券公司将依法解散，分支机构变更为中金公司分支机构。此外，东方资产和信达资产将分别成为中金公司的主要股东，持股比例为8.03%和16.76%。同时，中金公司将成为东兴基金和信达澳亚基金的主要股东，并控股东兴期货和信达期货。
text_en: The CSRC issued a reply agreeing to CICC's absorption and merger of Dongxing Securities and Xinda Securities. According to the reply, CICC will absorb and merge Dongxing Securities and Xinda Securities by issuing new shares. After the merger is completed, the two securities companies will be dissolved in accordance with law, and their branches will be changed into CICC branches. In addition, Orient Asset and Xinda Asset will respectively become major shareholders of CICC, with shareholding ratios of 8.03% and 16.76%. At the same time, CICC will become a major shareholder of Dongxing Fund and Xinda Auspice Fund and will control Dongxing Futures and Xinda Futures.
